shortDescription.default: Config-driven SharePoint list view, edit form and list designer

longDescription.default: Rhino Forms replaces PowerApps-style list forms with two web parts: the Rhino List Designer defines a list (with proper internal names), provisions it, lays out the form and configures the grid, saving a JSON config to Site Assets. The Rhino List web part reads that config and renders a fast, filterable, sortable grid with a beautiful add/edit form.
